subject: Superintendent Self-Evaluation Presentation
overview: The Medford School Committee of the Whole met to receive Superintendent Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent's 2022–2023 self-evaluation and confirm the committee's evaluation timeline and process.

items.title: Superintendent Self-Evaluation Presentation
items.summary: Superintendent Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent presented her 2022–2023 self-evaluation, highlighting progress on early literacy initiatives, school safety measures, district operations, and strategic focus standards.

items.title: Superintendent Evaluation Process and Timeline
items.summary: The committee reviewed instructions and confirmed deadlines for members to submit completed evaluation templates ahead of upcoming subcommittee composite review meetings.
